title: `server/discover`
description: The optional request that reports a server's supported protocol versions, capabilities, identity and instructions; servers must implement it, clients may skip it.
question: Does the framework use discovery to choose a protocol version?
why: This replaces the introspection half of the removed `initialize` handshake. A client that never calls it has to assume a version and find out it was wrong from a failed request, and it never sees the server's `instructions`.
known_issues: Measured by scripts/measure_protocol.py: each adapter runs against fixtures/base_protocol_server.py behind the wire recorder, and the cell is read from the captures.
The fixture lists one version (2026-07-28) in supportedVersions, so this row shows that the adapter discovers and then uses a listed version, not how it chooses between several.
